title: An Observational Study to Evaluate the Treatment of Newvast® Tab(Atorvastatin) in Korean Patients With Dyslipidemia

sections.abstract: In this study, dyslipidemia patients visited the institutions during the study period and the effectiveness and safety of the treatment of Newvast® Tab(Atorvastatin) in real-practice. During the routine medical visit, according to the investigator's judgment, with diagnosis that the Newvast® Tab(Atorvastatin) prescription is appropriate, regardless of medical history and concomitant-medication, and after deciding to start treatment, patients with Dyslipidemia who agreed to participate in the study were administered Newvast® Tab(Atorvastatin). As this study is a non-interventional observational study, all subjects received prescriptions according to the routine treatment procedure, and there were no visits or procedures required according to the observational study protocol.
